text:
Predicates:
WorksInLibrary(x) ::: x works in the library.
FromCSDepartment(x) ::: x is from the computer science department.
HasPartTimeJob(x) ::: x has a part-time job offered by the university.
TakesCourse(x, y) ::: x takes course y.
InstructorBy(x, y) ::: x instructs y.
Student(x) ::: x is a student.
WorksInLab(x) ::: x works in the lab.
Question: 
James is a student working in the lab. Jack neither has a part-time job offered by the university nor works in the lab.
Premises:
∀x (WorksInLibrary(x) → FromCSDepartment(x)) ::: No students who work in the library are from the computer science department.
∀x (HasPartTimeJob(x) → WorksInLibrary(x)) ::: All students who have part-time jobs offered by the university are students who work in the library.
∀x (TakesCourse(x, database)) → FromCSDepartment(x) ::: All students who take the database course are from the computer science department.
∀x (InstructorBy(x, y) → TakesCourse(x, database)) ::: All students instructed by professor David are taking the database course.
∀x (WorksInLab(x) → InstructorBy(x, professorDavid)) ::: All students working in the lab are instructed by professor David.
WorksInLab(james) ::: James is a student working in the lab.
¬HasPartTimeJob(jack) ∧ ¬WorksInLab(jack) ::: Jack neither has a part-time job offered by the university nor works in the lab.
Conclusion:
¬HasPartTimeJob(james) ::: James does not have a part-time job offered by the university.
